senses.gloss: cake baked on coals. Tanḥ. Bo 9 ואין ע׳ אלא לשון חררה ‘uggah has the meaning of ḥărarah (v. חֲרָרָה).—Pl. עוּגּוֹת. Ib. לא הספיקו לאפות ע׳ they had no time to bake cakes.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48">Gen. R. s. 48</cite> <he>שלש לע׳</he> (not <he>לעוגת</he>) three S’ah of flour were used for cakes.
